summary.text: Bobby Joe Champion is a Democratic state senator who represents District 59 and is the only candidate on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for the seat.
An attorney by training, he previously served in the Minnesota House of Representatives and took office in the Senate in 2013.

paragraphs.text: Champion earned a B.A. in political science from Macalester College and a J.D. from the William Mitchell College of Law.

His professional experience includes working as a practicing attorney, as an Assistant Attorney General, as an attorney for the Legal Rights Center, and in the music industry for Flyte Tyme Productions.
Champion represented District 58B in the Minnesota House of Representatives from 2009 to 2013 and assumed office in the State Senate on January 8, 2013.
His 2025-2026 committee assignments are Finance, Rules and Administration, and Jobs and Economic Growth Finance and Policy, which he chairs.
